method.panel: Fixed 50-task repository-stratified calibration panel; four budgets; mixed-source completion view
method.score_merge: Take official outcomes from latest v060 source-state. Apply v061 same-original-slot163 score to original candidate. For 13 remaining unknown slots, select explicitly labeled fresh_generation_recovery as a separate mixed-source observation; original unknowns remain unchanged.
method.costs: Reuse previously audited v056 slot-costs.csv for all retained original generations including slot163. Read embedded final ledgers from only the 13 fresh v061 generation result files. Sum all billed prompt and completion tokens including condenser usage. Inflight reservations are not usage.
method.stop_class: Reuse v060 slot-results.csv for 186 known originals; slot163 native_finished from its archived original controller; fresh recovery terminal_boundary or native_finished from v061 final summary.
method.denominator: 50 tasks per budget; actual token means/medians over all 50 selected episodes in each group, all of which have complete accounting.
method.unused_budget: Unspent token balance is token_limit minus actual_tokens; does not imply next complete input+32768 output reservation could fit. <2M is a strict actual_tokens threshold, not a claim another budget trajectory would succeed.
method.comparison: Pair by instance_id. Improve/regress labels are observed outcome changes, not causal effects. Each cell has a single sampled generation, with original and fresh recovery runtime/source differences.

limitations: Mixed original and fresh-recovery completion view is not the original 200 generation results and not a homogeneous rerun.
Official scoring revisions are heterogeneous across the retained original panel; upstream v060 source state retains provenance.
Same group success count does not mean identical success tasks; paired transitions are descriptive and do not identify budget causality.
Observed 50-task calibration panel is not a score on the complete 500-task SWE-bench Verified set.
Historical costs of the 13 original interrupted generations remain recorded and are excluded only from the selected-generation cost distribution, not from actual historical resource cost.
